text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd had packed into the Yasuda 
Kinen. Most of them seemed to be Oguri 
Cap's fans. Her popularity had reached 
fever pitch, nothing short of a cultural 
phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in the paddock, Oguri Cap's 
popularity is overwhelmingly evident.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Yaeno Muteki fired up her 
fighting spirit, ready to overturn the 
odds with her running. She charges 
headlong into a direct showdown with Oguri 
Cap!
